title: Enhance QA Puppeteer tests to prioritize critical bug detection and auto-create tasks
description:
The QA agent (qa-improvement-agent) already uses Puppeteer for visual testing and creates task files. Enhance its Puppeteer testing phase to be more thorough in detecting major/critical bugs that would break the demo:

1. Add console error monitoring — capture and classify JS errors during Puppeteer tests. Any unhandled exception should auto-generate a priority-1 task.
2. Add interaction failure detection — if a click/fill action doesn't produce the expected DOM change within 3 seconds, flag it as a priority-1 bug.
3. Add visual regression checks — screenshot key states (empty canvas, canvas with nodes, form open, form filled) and compare against expected layouts (no overlapping elements, no elements off-screen).
4. Add network error detection — catch failed fetch requests or 4xx/5xx responses during testing.
5. Ensure all critical user flows are tested every run:
   - Load app → verify canvas renders
   - Add node → verify it appears
   - Click node → verify form panel opens with correct data
   - Edit form → verify changes persist
   - Delete node → verify it's removed and form closes
   - Connect two nodes → verify edge appears
   - Zoom/pan → verify no rendering glitches

The agent should classify findings by severity and auto-create tasks with appropriate priority levels. Major bugs (broken core flows, console errors, visual breakage) get priority 1. Minor UX issues get priority 2-3.

Files to update: .kiro/agents/qa-improvement-agent.md (the agent prompt with enhanced Puppeteer instructions)
